recipes.name: Curried Chickpea Butternut Soup
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the curry powder, garam masala, coriander, cumin, turmeric, and chili flakes. Having them ready will help prevent burning when added later. Set aside.
In a large pot, heat the oil over medium-high heat. Add the onion and garlic and cook for 3 to 4 minutes, until the onion is translucent.
Add the ginger and the spice mixture and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 to 2 minutes to toast the spices.
Add the squash, tomatoes, vegetable broth, and salt. Reduce the heat to medium, cover the pot, and simmer for 10 to 12 minutes, until the squash is tender.
Use an immersion blender or countertop blender to partially blend the soup.
Stir in the chickpeas and coconut milk. Let the soup heat through. Taste and add more salt if you like.
Serve as is, or garnish with cilantro and/or a squeeze of fresh lemon juice with some vegan naan on the side. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † For us, 1 small butternut squash weighed 1½ lb / 680g. † For us, 6 medium tomatoes weighed 1½ lb / 680g. † One (13.5 oz / 400ml) can yields about 1⅔ cups.
Storage Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 3 days. Freeze for up to 2 months.
